title: Improve Target ROI Comparison seed handling and interpretation quality
commands_run: python -m py_compile app\V2\ui\strategy_simulation_tab.py core\streamlit_services\strategy_simulation_service.py (hit Windows pyc lock)
python explicit py_compile with temporary cfile for app/V2/ui/strategy_simulation_tab.py core/streamlit_services/strategy_simulation_service.py
python read-only sqlite ADA seed query
python inline ADA live_position_seed sample comparison

seed_modes.synthetic_empty: Available; explicitly starts from zero exposure.
seed_modes.live_position_seed: Available; uses live/current position aggregates, current price, weighted entries, and live equity when present.
seed_modes.live_lots_seed: Available; uses open position_lots when present and warns/falls back safely when unavailable.
seed_modes.manual_seed: Available; uses the existing manual Seed state inputs.

live_ada_seed_behavior.fallback_warning: No open ADA lots were present in read-only DB query; live_position_seed remains explicit and non-empty.

summary: Target ROI Comparison now has explicit seed modes, uses live position aggregates instead of silently behaving like an empty synthetic seed, supports live lots seed input when open lots exist, adds harvest-informativeness metrics and warnings for no-close/no-realized-PnL runs, and replaces heavy raw JSON rendering with compact collapsed previews plus download JSON.
